en.text: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！ 因为他行过奇妙的事； 他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要向耶和華唱新歌！ 因為他行過奇妙的事； 他的右手和聖臂施行救恩。

en.text: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华发明了他的救恩， 在列邦人眼前显出公义；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華發明了他的救恩， 在列邦人眼前顯出公義；

en.text: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

zhSimplified.text: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。 地的四极都看见我们 神的救恩。

zhTraditional.text: 記念他向以色列家所發的慈愛，所憑的信實。 地的四極都看見我們上帝的救恩。

en.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

zhSimplified.text: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐； 要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！

zhTraditional.text: 全地都要向耶和華歡樂； 要發起大聲，歡呼歌頌！

en.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

zhSimplified.text: 要用琴歌颂耶和华， 用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！

zhTraditional.text: 要用琴歌頌耶和華， 用琴和詩歌的聲音歌頌他！

en.text: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 用号和角声， 在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！

zhTraditional.text: 用號和角聲， 在大君王耶和華面前歡呼！

en.text: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

zhSimplified.text: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃； 世界和住在其间的也要发声。

zhTraditional.text: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃； 世界和住在其間的也要發聲。

en.text: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

zhSimplified.text: 愿大水拍手； 愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；

zhTraditional.text: 願大水拍手； 願諸山在耶和華面前一同歡呼；

en.text: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他来要审判遍地。 他要按公义审判世界， 按公正审判万民。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他來要審判遍地。 他要按公義審判世界， 按公正審判萬民。
